Class MetroOptimizer.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.MetroOptimizer.Builder
Enclosing class:
MetroOptimizer
public static final class MetroOptimizer.Builder extends Object
The primary builder for assembling an optimization request. Provides fluent methods to define sites, provider requirements, workloads, constraints, and scoring strategy before executing the optimization via optimize().

  • Method Details

    • addSite

      public MetroOptimizer.SiteBuilder addSite(String label)
      Begins defining a user site (workforce location, customer market, or operational facility). The returned MetroOptimizer.SiteBuilder provides methods to specify the site's metro proximity, geographic coordinates, role, and headcount.
      Parameters:
      label - a descriptive name for this site (e.g., "NYC Headquarters")
      Returns:
      a new MetroOptimizer.SiteBuilder for configuring the site

    • requireProvider

      public MetroOptimizer.ProviderBuilder requireProvider(CloudProviderType cloudProvider)
      Begins defining a required cloud provider. The optimizer will penalize or exclude metros where this provider is not available.
      Parameters:
      cloudProvider - the well-known cloud provider type (e.g., CloudProviderType.AWS)
      Returns:
      a new MetroOptimizer.ProviderBuilder for configuring additional provider details

    • requireProvider

      public MetroOptimizer.ProviderBuilder requireProvider(String serviceProfileName)
      Begins defining a required service profile provider by name. The optimizer will penalize or exclude metros where this service profile is not available.
      Parameters:
      serviceProfileName - the Fabric service profile name to require
      Returns:
      a new MetroOptimizer.ProviderBuilder for configuring additional provider details

    • preferProvider

      public MetroOptimizer.ProviderBuilder preferProvider(CloudProviderType cloudProvider)
      Begins defining a preferred (but not required) cloud provider. Metros with this provider available will receive a scoring bonus, but metros without it are not excluded.
      Parameters:
      cloudProvider - the preferred cloud provider type
      Returns:
      a new MetroOptimizer.ProviderBuilder for configuring additional provider details

    • preferProvider

      public MetroOptimizer.ProviderBuilder preferProvider(String serviceProfileName)
      Begins defining a preferred (but not required) service profile provider by name. Metros with this provider available will receive a scoring bonus.
      Parameters:
      serviceProfileName - the preferred Fabric service profile name
      Returns:
      a new MetroOptimizer.ProviderBuilder for configuring additional provider details

    • addWorkload

      public MetroOptimizer.WorkloadBuilder addWorkload(String label)
      Begins defining a workload to be placed by the optimizer. The returned MetroOptimizer.WorkloadBuilder provides methods to specify the workload type, bandwidth, latency requirements, and provider dependencies.
      Parameters:
      label - a descriptive name for this workload (e.g., "ML Training Pipeline")
      Returns:
      a new MetroOptimizer.WorkloadBuilder for configuring the workload

    • constraints

      public MetroOptimizer.ConstraintsBuilder constraints()
      Opens the constraints builder for defining hard and soft limits on the optimization search space, including budget, region/metro restrictions, compliance zones, redundancy requirements, and latency bounds.
      Returns:
      a new MetroOptimizer.ConstraintsBuilder for configuring optimization constraints

    • strategy

      public MetroOptimizer.Builder strategy(OptimizationStrategy strategy)
      Sets the optimization strategy, which determines the default scoring weight distribution across latency, provider coverage, cost, redundancy, and compliance. Defaults to OptimizationStrategy.BALANCED if not set.
      Parameters:
      strategy - the optimization strategy to use
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
      See Also:
      • OptimizationStrategy

    • scoringWeights

      public MetroOptimizer.Builder scoringWeights(ScoringWeights weights)
      Sets custom scoring weights and latency thresholds that override the strategy defaults. Only non-null fields in the provided ScoringWeights take precedence; null fields fall back to the selected strategy's defaults.
      Parameters:
      weights - the custom scoring weights and thresholds
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
      See Also:
      • ScoringWeights

    • rateCard

      public MetroOptimizer.Builder rateCard(RateCard rateCard)
      Sets the rate card used for cost estimation. When omitted, the optimizer defaults to live Equinix pricing (EquinixRateCard.of(fabric)), falling back to a built-in regional heuristic for any metro the live catalogue cannot price. Supply a CustomRateCard to cost against your own negotiated rates.
      Parameters:
      rateCard - the rate card to estimate costs with
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining

    • term

      public MetroOptimizer.Builder term(Term term)
      Sets the commitment term used when resolving rates. Defaults to Term.MONTH_12.
      Parameters:
      term - the commitment term
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining

    • optimize

      public OptimizationResult optimize()
      Executes the optimization pipeline. Assembles an OptimizationRequest from the configured sites, providers, workloads, constraints, strategy, and scoring weights, then delegates to the internal MetroOptimizerEngine for scoring and ranking.

      This method makes live API calls to retrieve metro and service profile data from Equinix Fabric. The Fabric client must be authenticated before calling this method.

      Returns:
      the complete optimization result with ranked recommendations, topology, and reports
      See Also:
      • OptimizationResult
